annotations.title: Brazilian Fund Holdings of a Stock

description: Get the Brazilian investment funds holding one B3 share, written BVMF:TICKER (e.g. BVMF:PETR4), from each fund's monthly portfolio, largest position first: the fund and its manager, the month, shares held (counting shares lent out), their value in reais, the position's percentage of the fund's net assets and the change in shares from the fund's previous month. Funds may keep positions confidential for a few months, so each fund answers with its newest month that kept nothing confidential, dated per row; a fund that stopped reporting, or whose newest such month is over a year old, is left out. For US registered funds use GetFundsHoldingStock; for Canadian funds GetCanadianFundHoldings.

maxResults.description: Maximum funds, largest position first (default 20, max 100).

ticker.description: B3 listing symbol BVMF:TICKER, e.g. BVMF:PETR4. A bare ticker names a US listing and is answered with the company's B3 listings to ask with.
